head_commit.message:
fix: adapt verify-package to real fnpack layout and ensure exec bits

fnpack wraps app/ as app.tgz inside the archive (verified on fnOS);
unpack and check the payload from there. chmod before packing so
cross-platform copies cannot drop exec bits.
